title: Huawei OceanStor Dorado DeviceManager connector configuration

credential_reference_id.description: References a username:password pair, not a pre-built Authorization header -- OceanStor's real REST API requires a stateful login (POST .../sessions) to obtain a session token, unlike Hitachi and Brocade's per-request static header schemes. See source-provenance.json's authentication_source.

system_id.description: The OceanStor system identifier embedded in every DeviceManager REST URL. One configured connector instance manages exactly one Dorado system, unlike Hitachi's single Configuration Manager fronting many arrays.
